disease_state: Mass spectrometry-based proteomic analysis of urinary EV (uEV) in men with benign and malignant prostate disease allowed us to significantly expand the known human uEV proteome with high specificity and identifies a unique biological profile in prostate cancer not uncovered by the analysis of soluble proteins.
material_type: Urine is considered an ideal proximal fluid for the study of EV in urological cancers due to its direct contact with the urogenital system.
